title: The Awakening
author: Kate Chopin
summary: Edna Pontellier, a wife and mother in 1890s Louisiana, begins to resist the roles expected of her. A summer on the Gulf coast awakens a hunger for independence, art and love outside her marriage.
readIf: you enjoy short, lyrical classics about a woman pushing against the limits of her time.
skipIf: you want a plot-driven story or a happy resolution.
